name: PEGASE 1354-bus case (part of the European high-voltage network, fictitious data)
source: Data of the PEGASE project (Pan European Grid Advanced Simulation and State Estimation, 7th Framework Programme of the European Union): C. Josz, S. Fliscounakis, J. Maeght, P. Panciatici, «AC power flow data in MATPOWER and QCQP format: iTesla, RTE snapshots, and PEGASE», arXiv:1603.01533, 2016; S. Fliscounakis, P. Panciatici, F. Capitanescu, L. Wehenkel, «Contingency ranking with respect to overloads in very large power systems taking into account uncertainty, preventive and corrective actions», IEEE Trans. Power Systems 28(4), 2013. As distributed with MATPOWER (case1354pegase.m), © 2015, 2016 by the authors of the first reference, licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes here: converted to the format of this project (elements in per unit); no value was changed. The data are fictitious: they have the size and the complexity of a part of the European 380 and 220 kV network and do not describe the real one. Generators: rating = mBase and x″d = 0,2 pu are typical values for the short circuit, not part of the data.
